Good to know

Event questions

How do tickets work?

Reserve through the campaign’s donation page using the Get Tickets button above. Tickets are for individuals only — personal checks are welcome. Questions? Contact Elizabeth Banks.

What’s the schedule for the evening?

The VIP / Cohost reception for $1,000+ donors runs 5:30 – 6:00 PM, followed by the general happy hour from 6:00 – 7:30 PM.

Can I bring a guest?

Yes — every guest needs their own ticket, as tickets are sold to individuals only.

Where do I park?

On-site parking is available at West Run Ranch – you will see signs at the entry after you turn in at 750 State Road 207.

Is food served?

Heavy charcuterie and hors d’oeuvres throughout the evening, with a bourbon and wine tasting planned.
